+def widened_hostnames(hostname: Optional[str]) -> Iterable[str]:
+    """Yield a hostname, then each parent obtained by removing its first label.
+
+    For example, a.b.c yields a.b.c, b.c, and c. Empty input yields nothing.
+    """
+    while hostname:
+        yield hostname
+        hostname = hostname.partition('.')[2]
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source', ['_blocked_hosts', '_config_blocked_hosts'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('request_url, blocked', [
+    ('https://example.com/', True),
+    ('https://sub.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com./path', True),
+    ('https://example.com./path', True),
+    ('https://notexample.com/', False),
+    ('https://example.com.evil/', False),
+])
+def test_parent_domain_blocking(
+    config_stub, host_blocker_factory, source, request_url, blocked
+):
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = None
+
+    blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    getattr(blocker, source).add('example.com')
+
+    assert blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(request_url)) is blocked
+
+
+def test_parent_domain_whitelist(config_stub, host_blocker_factory):
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = ['https://a.b.example.com/allowed']
+
+    blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    blocker._blocked_hosts.add('example.com')
+
+    assert not blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://a.b.example.com/allowed'))
+    assert blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://a.b.example.com/other'))
+
+
